Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
1) When a CI'd vampire is Banished, is CI affecting him while
he is uncontrolled, or only when he comes into play?
That is, if I clan impersonate a Gargoyle to Tremere, and then
he gets Banished, can I use the Arcane Library to feed him?

2) Can a Sterile Tremere perform the Create Gargoyle action?
While it is an action that creates a new vampire, it's not quite
the same as an Embrace...

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message
news:A6GV7.36588$5W5.13...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net...

> 1) When a CI'd vampire is Banished, is CI affecting him while
> he is uncontrolled, or only when he comes into play?
> That is, if I clan impersonate a Gargoyle to Tremere, and then
> he gets Banished, can I use the Arcane Library to feed him?

I think not. Cards played on vampire -like CI- are considered out of game as
long as the vampire is placed in the uncontrolled region -they do not
contest nor interact with other cards in play.

> 2) Can a Sterile Tremere perform the Create Gargoyle action?
> While it is an action that creates a new vampire, it's not quite
> the same as an Embrace...

No. Create gargoyle is an action that creates a new vampire. A sterile
vampire is prohibited from performing that action.

reyda
